entries.title: Proverbs 26:1
segments: ¶As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:2
segments: ¶As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:3
segments: ¶A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool's back.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:4
segments: ¶Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:5
segments: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit. {conceit: Heb. eyes}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:6
segments: ¶He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, [and] drinketh damage. {damage: or, violence}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:7
segments: The legs of the lame are not equal: so [is] a parable in the mouth of fools. {are...: Heb. are lifted up}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:8
segments: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so [is] he that giveth honour to a fool. {bindeth...: or, putteth a precious stone in an heap of stones}

words.text: . {bindeth...: or, putteth a precious stone in an heap of stones}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:9
segments: [As] a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so [is] a parable in the mouth of fools.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:10
segments: ¶The great [God] that formed all [things] both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors. {The great...: or, A great man grieveth all, and he hireth the fool, he hireth also transgressors}

words.text: . {The great...: or, A great man grieveth all, and he hireth the fool, he hireth also transgressors}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:11
segments: ¶As a dog returneth to his vomit, [so] a fool returneth to his folly. {returneth to his folly: Heb. iterateth his folly}

words.text: . {returneth to his folly: Heb. iterateth his folly}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:12
segments: ¶Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? [there is] more hope of a fool than of him.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:13
segments: ¶The slothful [man] saith, [There is] a lion in the way; a lion [is] in the streets.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:14
segments: ¶[As] the door turneth upon his hinges, so [doth] the slothful upon his bed.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:15
segments: ¶The slothful hideth his hand in [his] bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth. {it grieveth...: or, he is weary}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:16
segments: ¶The sluggard [is] wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:17
segments: ¶He that passeth by, [and] meddleth with strife [belonging] not to him, [is like] one that taketh a dog by the ears. {meddleth: or, is enraged}

words.text: [belonging] not to him, [is like] one that taketh

entries.title: Proverbs 26:18
segments: ¶As a mad [man] who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death, {firebrands: Heb. flames, or, sparks}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:19
segments: So [is] the man [that] deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?

entries.title: Proverbs 26:20
segments: ¶Where no wood is, [there] the fire goeth out: so where [there is] no talebearer, the strife ceaseth. {Where no...: Heb. Without wood} {talebearer: or, whisperer} {ceaseth: Heb. is silent}

words.text: . {Where no...: Heb. Without wood} {talebearer: or, whisperer} {ceaseth: Heb. is silent}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:21
segments: [As] coals [are] to burning coals, and wood to fire; so [is] a contentious man to kindle strife.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:22
segments: The words of a talebearer [are] as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly. {innermost...: Heb. chambers}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:23
segments: ¶Burning lips and a wicked heart [are like] a potsherd covered with silver dross.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:24
segments: ¶He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him; {dissembleth: or, is known}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:25
segments: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for [there are] seven abominations in his heart. {speaketh...: Heb. maketh his voice gracious}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:26
segments: [Whose] hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the [whole] congregation. {by...: or, in secret}

entries.title: Proverbs 26:27
segments: ¶Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:28
segments: ¶A lying tongue hateth [those that are] afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
